question: What are the EC numbers of the two most commonly used chemicals for the virus testing method in the paper about SPFMV and SPCSV in the Pearl Of Africa from 2016? Return the semicolon-separated numbers in the order of the alphabetized chemicals.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content:
On the Wiley page. Scrolled to Materials and Methods > Virus testing. Key details observed:
- Leaf discs ground in ELISA extraction buffer.
- Tests used: NCM-ELISA; DAS and TAS ELISA.
- DAS-ELISA kit contained coating antibody IgG and detecting antibody IgG-AP (alkaline phosphatase conjugate).
- TAS-ELISA kit contained primary rabbit IgG, secondary mouse MAb, and detection antibody rabbit anti-mouse IgG-AP.
- Substrate: p-nitrophenyl phosphate (pNPP). Measured absorbance at 405 nm.
- Did not see horseradish peroxidase explicitly in this section.
Candidate chemicals detected in-text: alkaline phosphatase conjugates; p-nitrophenyl phosphate (substrate).
